# Gramlot examples 0.3.22

- Add the optional Kajenn/Asqueel customer catalogue with real SQLite reads and committed saves.
- Show separate PageStore controllers, binders, publication-triggered saves and status/error data.
- Cover direct/nested iframes and connected descendant windows sharing one primary WebSocket.
- Demonstrate missing records, required fields, duplicate-email rollback and recovery. Each page keeps an independent draft; reload reads another window's committed save.

The Python catalogue is in `gramlot_examples.trials.kajenn_db`; its host runner is in gramlot-py-server. Use the matching Kajenn integration and `kajenn-db[asqueel]`. The existing hosted galleries retain the standard catalogue. This example uses synchronous controllers and does not resolve Kajenn #89's async database cancellation issue.
